mapper.sql: b.id, b.tenant_id, b.banner_title, b.image_file_id, b.display_positions, b.sort_no, b.status, b.remark, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_by, b.updated_at, b.deleted
b.id, b.tenant_id, b.banner_title, b.image_file_id, b.display_positions, b.position_config, b.sort_no, b.status, b.remark, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_by, b.updated_at, b.deleted
FROM sys_banner b LEFT JOIN infra_file f ON f.id = b.image_file_id AND f.deleted = 0

sql.where:
b.deleted = 0
AND b.banner_title like concat('%', #{bannerTitle}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{displayPosition}, b.display_positions)
AND b.status = #{status}

mapper.select:
SELECT , f.file_url AS image_preview_url
WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0

SELECT , f.file_url AS image_preview_url
WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = '0' AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND FIND_IN_SET(#{displayPosition}, b.display_positions) ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
